messages:
Priya: Heads up — in the compact table experiment the action icons are visually cramped when the filter bar is sticky. Users missed the kebab in our quick test.
Marco: Ugh yeah. Which page? dashboard or rules table?
Priya: Rules table, compact mode with multi-select. The kebab sits flush to the cell edge and the checkbox column feels like it steals space.
Sam: Could we give the action cell a small token that expands hit area only (not visual size)? e.g. `--token-compact-action-hit: 32px` used as padding but keep icon 20px.
Jo: Love that. Also we should keep touch target 44px for mobile. For desktop 32px + clear focus ring is fine.
Priya: Copy/UX: when people hit the action and then delete, the toast pops under the header and overlaps filters. It currently says just "Deleted". Can we standardize to "Deleted <object> — Undo" and show toasts above the footer, anchored bottom-right on dense pages?
Marco: Do we have a toast offset token? I think `--toast-offset-y` exists but not per-page. Maybe add `--toast-anchor-bottom-offset-desktop` so pages with sticky headers can opt out.
Sam: Implementation note: we can use absolute positioning inside the page container: `.page-toasts { position: absolute; right: 24px; bottom: var(--toast-offset-bottom, 24px); }` keeps toasts from colliding with sticky header.
figma-bot: Prototype updated: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/compact-table-actions (frame: compact-table-v3).
Jo: Accessibility: kebab must be a `<button>` with `aria-haspopup="menu"` and SR label "Actions for <rule name>". Menu items sentence case, action first: "Delete rule", "Duplicate rule".
Priya: Keyboard flow: Tab to row -> Enter to open kebab -> Arrow keys to pick. Make sure the menu is appended to body so it doesn't get clipped by overflow: hidden on table container.
Marco: If menu is in body we need to manage focus return explicitly. Also ensure menu receives `role="menu"` and items `role="menuitem"`.
Sam: For visuals: keep ghost primary only when the row has >1 action OR when an item is hovered. That prevents clutter. CSS snippet idea: `:host([compact]) .action-btn { min-width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 6px; }`
Jo: Also test with screen reader — announcing toast: use `role="status"` and `aria-live="polite"` for the toast container so SR gets "Deleted 1 rule. Undo."
Priya: I'll schedule 6 quick hallway tests (5-7 mins) to validate discoverability and toast overlap.
Marco: I'll whip up a small token PR: `tokens/spacing: add compact-action-hit 6px` and a tiny CSS utility.
Sam: I'll draft the code change and add a story in Storybook for compact table states.
Jo: I'll add an accessibility checklist to the Figma file and link to the PR.
Priya: Thanks everyone. Goal: land a small pragmatic fix (hit area + toast anchor) this week and iterate if usability shows problems. :raised_hands:
